messages:
alice: Heads-up — main CI flipped red right after merge of PR #4321 (commit 7b9f2a). Failing step: gpu-e2e / serve-smoke. CI link: https://ci.internal/1850000000
deploy-bot: CI pipeline 1850000000 FAILED on step `gpu-e2e`: exit code 1. Logs attached.
ben: @alice can you paste the failing stack/log? Is this infra flake or a regression from the PR?
alice: Pasted snippet from the job log:
```
ServingRuntimeError: GPU OOM when allocating KV cache
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/e2e/serve_test.py", line 142, in test_smoke
    start_model_server()
  File "runtime/serve.py", line 78, in start_model_server
    allocate_kvcache(batch_size)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
carmen: I can take an initial bisect. @ben can you try a quick repro on the dev cluster? If it's OOM maybe PR changed default quantization or max_batch.
ben: Running a repro now on dev-gpu-1. If this is the merge, we can hotfix by pinning the model variant or reverting the runtime config change. @sre-rotation any burst capacity?
sre-rotation: We have limited burst capacity on prod-gpu-pool for ~20m. We could route traffic to dedicated pool temporarily but prefer to fix the cause.
alice: I queued a rerun for the failed job: https://ci.internal/1850000000/retry and PR 4321 is the only change touching runtime defaults: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321
carmen: If rerun passes it's flaky; if it fails I'll start bisection across the last ~10 merges. Collect nvprof/cuda logs while bisecting. Quick repro command: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python tests/e2e/repro_realtime.py --model small`.
ben: Rerun queued... jobs started (3/3). Pinged @oncall-sre.
deploy-bot: Rerun started by alice. New job id: 1850000001.
alice: Rerun failed, same OOM on ci-prod-1, reproduced.
ben: OK starting bisect. @carmen do you want me to open a revert PR for 4321 so it's ready if bisect points at it? We should avoid immediate revert until we confirm.
carmen: Please don't revert blindly — start bisect first. If bisect isolates 4321, then revert + promote hotfix.
sre-rotation: Sounds good. If you revert, we'll prep a hotfix deploy and notify any impacted customers. Keep us updated.
ben: I'll open a bisect thread and run binary search across the merge window, dropping exact test repros and nvprof dumps into that thread. Starting now.
alice: Thanks y'all — I'll mirror logs to #incidents if we need escalation. :thumbsup:
